value.rationale: The third factorial moment of the count of returns at the first three equally spaced times equals six times the computed probability and cannot be recovered from one- and two-event marginals. A universal sharp threshold locates the first genuinely three-frequency off-diagonal recurrence cluster, and its strict separation from the pair threshold for a>2 establishes a structural difference between pairwise and triple recurrences. The complete base-two six-piece law provides an exact natural benchmark for finite-time higher-order self-return clustering. The statement concerns a natural family of all integer expanders, not an arbitrary numerical slice, and its limitations are explicitly bounded.
